comparison.objective: Candidate depins a terminal; record prepares an insulin pen with a safety shot and dials a dose.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-under-tab insertion and coupled pull versus shield removal, orientation control, forceful button depression, timed hold, and dose dialing.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks intact selective extraction with missing numeric force/damage thresholds. Record checks shield placement, exact 2-unit purge, needle-up angle, visible drop, 5-second hold, and final 12-unit setting.
comparison.reason: The sequence, mechanisms, and safety-critical end states differ.
